Definition: Overall descriptive analyses use 152 genomes. Reference-assigned group comparisons use 144 genomes (23 subflava, 114 perflava, 7 flavescens). Eight species-unresolved genomes contribute to the overall descriptive analyses and are excluded from the primary reference-group comparisons.
Strict core: 152/152; core: 151/152; soft core: 145–150/152; shell: 23–144/152; cloud: 1–22/152. Main figures combine strict core and core as core ≥99%.

PGAP2 orth98 is primary; orth95 is the identity-threshold sensitivity dictionary. Cluster identifiers are not interchangeable. Group repertoires use subsets of the shared orth98 dictionary, not independent reconstructions.

reference_groups_144 uses 23/114/7 genomes. ANI_assignment_sensitivity_152 assigns all 152 genomes by ANI channel (31/114/7), including eight species-unresolved genomes. Mantel tests use all 152 genomes. all_variable includes every non-strict-core cluster.

PERMANOVA uses raw Jaccard distances. PERMDISP uses bias-adjusted distances to group medians with Lingoes correction and residual permutations. restricted_within_study_namespace denotes within-study permutations; 999 draws per test.
Coordinates use shell/cloud Jaccard distances and Lingoes correction. Axis fractions use positive corrected eigenvalues.
Means and 2.5th–97.5th percentiles come from 1,000 random genome orders. Intervals describe order variation, not confidence intervals from independent biological replicates.
Mantel correlations use patristic distances from the unmasked core-genome tree and are conditional descriptive comparisons; robustness to recombination was not established.
